plan: Preserve the original: adapt() deep-copies ingredients/components and copies instructions/equipment before any edit; print_original() returns authored_text verbatim, so originals stay printable byte-for-byte.
Rational scaling: compute scale = target_yield / recipe yield as a Fraction and multiply every ingredient quantity (including component and later-added ingredients) as it enters the pipeline.

Deterministic choice: index the catalog by the 'for' name and rank options by (priority, catalog index); the head of that ranking is always chosen, giving explicit-priority determinism with authored order as tie-breaker.

Substitution chains: for each ingredient whose name is excluded, repeatedly apply the best catalog result, tracking a per-ingredient seen-name set; a repeated name yields 'substitution cycle involving NAME', a missing option yields 'no substitution for NAME'. The seen-set grows every step, so the loop provably terminates.

Dependent-field updates per applied result: quantity *= quantity_factor, unit/preparation replacement (with a warning when the unit changes), explicit wording_changes applied to instruction text, then a global rewrite of the old excluded name to the new name across instructions and all live preparations so no excluded name survives anywhere.

Equipment effects: equipment_add/equipment_remove mutate a working set with warnings; after all substitutions, every remaining item not in available_equipment contributes an 'equipment NAME unavailable' reason.

Worklist re-entry: additional_ingredients from a result are deep-copied, warned about, and appended to the same processing queue, so a reintroduced excluded ingredient is detected and re-substituted exactly like an authored one (chained adaptation).

Collect-then-decide: reasons and warnings are sets filled throughout without early exit, so every independently applicable reason is reported; output returns sorted reasons/warnings, ordered chosen catalog IDs, and either the complete adapted recipe at target yield (sorted equipment, optional yield_factor compensation so the yield lands exactly on target) or recipe = null.

Self-check block under __main__ executes the acceptance contract: 3→5 scaling, chained substitution butter→margarine→olive oil, wording-change of a referenced verb plus mixer→whisk equipment swap, exclusion reintroduced via an additional ingredient, three simultaneous impossibility reasons, input non-mutation with exact original print, and priority-over-catalog-order determinism.
mechanisms: deep-copy working set with verbatim authored_text return (original preservation)
Fraction ratio yield scaling applied at pipeline entry
catalog index ranked by (priority, catalog order) for deterministic selection
per-ingredient seen-set loop for chained substitution and cycle detection
global text rewrite: explicit wording_changes then excluded-name replacement across instructions and preparations
worklist queue so additional ingredients re-enter the same exclusion/substitution pipeline
accumulating reason/warning sets with no early exit, emitted sorted
equipment working set with add/remove effects checked against available_equipment after substitutions
yield_factor compensation dividing final quantities so the adapted recipe lands exactly on the target yield
